messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: loo repository moved to stan-dev
parts:
For any stan-users interested in or already using the loo R package for LOO-CV and WAIC: 

The GitHub repository hosting the loo R package has been moved to stan-dev and now resides at https://github.com/stan-dev/loo (it was formerly on my personal GitHub account). To report issues and do any other GitHub-related activities please use the new stan-dev location.

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: loo repository moved to stan-dev
parts: There will also be a loo update on CRAN within the next few days, but it will not contain any major changes. This release will only serve to update URLs in the package documentation to point to the new location of the repository (and fix a few typos). We are working on new content for the package (related to model comparisons), but this will come in a future release.
